preconditions.description: l is an integer within the range from 1 to 10^800.
r is an integer within the range from l to 10^800.
n is an integer within the range from 1 to 2000.

postconditions.description: The first line of output contains the maximum number of modest substrings.

postconditions.expression: output_line2 == string of length n with the maximum number of modest substrings
postconditions.description: The second line of output contains a string of length n that has the maximum number of modest substrings.

postconditions.expression: if multiple strings have the same number of modest substrings, output the lexicographically smallest one
postconditions.description: If there are multiple strings with the same number of modest substrings, the output should be the lexicographically smallest string.
